Coping with Stress

Some strategies for coping with stress are shown in the picture below:


When the kettle boils...

  1. Use constructive work or active leisure to release negative emotions
  2. Maintain a positive outlook
  3. Look at the humorous side of a situation
  4. Slow down and take on one problem at a time
  5. Set reasonable levels of achievement for yourself and others
  6. Work and leisure should complement each other

RELAX - sometimes the best way to tackle a problem is to get away from it for a little while, enabling you a to get a fresh start when you return.
